source: Publisher documentation saved under e3/truth/docs/fresh/ (sha256 in SHA256SUMS): TPC-DS v3.2.0; LDBC SNB specification (v2.2.5-SNAPSHOT, Appendix D for the Interactive v1 legacy data sets); GTFS Schedule Reference; FAA ardata.pdf (5/8/2025); ABS ASGS Edition 3 web pages; SEC Financial Statement Data Sets; College Scorecard Field of Study documentation (October 2026) and data dictionary; EPA AirData FileFormats (v3.0.0); 2024 ACS PUMS data dictionary and Census regions and divisions; City of Chicago portal metadata (ijzp-q8t2, c7ck-438e); USDA FoodData Central download field descriptions (October 2020)
rule: Sigma* is the set of FDs that the publisher documentation implies among the attributes of each relation, projected and closed over the dropped columns, each with a verbatim quote; sure when the quoted text states it (declared key, foreign key to a declared key, an explicit one-to-one or nesting statement), unsure when it needs an inference the text does not spell out. Dependencies the documentation hints at but does not state are listed under undocumented_regularities and are not part of Sigma*. Written from the documentation alone, before any data file was opened.

instance.generator: public data fixed before download for the confirmatory evaluation, joined by fresh.py
instance.construction: Same LDBC SNB Interactive v1 SF1 CsvCompositeMergeForeign-LongDateFormatter files: person_studyAt_organisation (root; 8,808 edges at SF1 for the full network per Table B.1) left-joined to person on Person.id and to organisation on Organisation.id, then to the place file in six roles (the person's city, country, continent; the university's city, country, continent) along place and isPartOf; dropped person.language and person.email (multi-valued composite attributes), organisation.type (constant University for the target of studyAt) and the url and type columns of the place roles.

cleaning.missing_values: empty and missing references become '?', kept as a value (null = null)

truth.clause: ldbc-snb-specification.pdf, Section 3.2.2 (p. 23): "Multiple edges (i.e. edges of the same type between two entity instances) are not allowed in SNB graphs."; Table 3.10 (p. 24): "studyAt Person[0..*] University[0..*]" with attribute classYear "The year the person graduated"; ldbc-snb-specification.pdf, Appendix D.1.2, Table D.7 (Files output by the CsvCompositeMergeForeign serializer, p. 162): "person_studyAt_organisation_*.csv Person.id | Organisation.id | classYear"
truth.justification: At most one studyAt edge joins a person and a university, and the edge carries one classYear; Person[0..*] University[0..*] is a documented non-dependency: neither id alone determines the other.
